overview: At home the tables show the line you wrote in the parlour, Edith viij s. owing. Lady Day. It is not your debt. It is not paid. You did not set a coffer total next to it, and you did not open an expected column.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Kept the line, and did not strike it.

parties.name: Edith Kettlewood
parties.context: Named on the tables. Not in the room.

assets.name: Edith's eight shillings
assets.disposition: Looked at Edith's line on the tables
